snippet.title: FEED MY MECH | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3906110/FEED_MY_MECH

Your mech is all that stands between you and what writhes below. FEED MY MECH is a short horror experience—venture into a dead underground colony and recover lost tech. But something is spreading through the machines… and it’s looking for a way inside your mech.

#gamedev #madewithunity #indiedev #analoghorror #IndieGameDev
